# Assembling your Elements 

You will ensure that your data and plotting scripts needed for creating your plot are used to build the up-to-date version of the plot.

## Code Block for Sourcing Your Scripts

```{r}
# source data-related scripts
library(here)
library(tidyverse)
source(here::here("data/processed/data_merged.R"))$value

# source plotting script(s)
source(here::here("ig_plot_code.R"))

```

## The Modified Plot

I added smaller units on the y-axis so that it would be easier for a view to interpret my results. I also completely changed the essence of the graph to use double visual encoding. I thought that it would be more usefull to look at this specific relationship than the previous so it is a slight tweak from before.




## Code Block for Embedding your PNG

```{r}
# plot with a caption

#| fig.cap: "Straight-set win rates by ranking group"
#| fig.align: "center" # to center plot on page if desired
#| out.width: "100%"   # or some other % appropriate for you site

knitr::include_graphics(here::here("figs", "straight_set_win_rates.png"))
```
